wire.t: No new trades since Friday's three-pack. On Saturday paknight12 dropped Kendre Miller (1:25 PM ET) and Raheim Sanders (1:01 PM ET) from Bourbon Lover, and nobody else made a move. Mark Andrews' 3.4 from Thursday still counts for Bourbon Lover this week even though The Champ now owns him, because he was already locked into the Bourbon Lover lineup when the game kicked off.

Thursday night's Jacksonville–Baltimore game is the only Week 9 football played so far. Jefferson’s Reserve (jmello16) leads Catfan94’s Farm Team (jrsmith1391) 26.48 to 0.00, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte (Bill_Buttlicker) leads OBJAY 30.8 to 0.00, Hold My DK leads Bourbon Lover 7.08 to 3.4, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell (Br0phy) is at -0.3 from Joe Fagnano against Asian Jim at 0.00.

Breece Hall (quad) was inactive for Week 8, and FantasyPros called a Week 9 return against Kansas City realistic. Check the Sunday inactives before kickoff. Hall belongs to Catfan94’s Farm Team, which is already 26.48 behind after Thursday.

Lamar Jackson is headed to injured reserve with a thumb injury that needs surgery and could end his season, FantasyPros reports. Jackson belongs to Bourbon Lover (paknight12) after Friday's trade. Joe Fagnano, who is on Dude, Your Getting a Dell, started Thursday for Baltimore.

Jeremiyah Love (ARI) was ruled out against the Rams after re-aggravating a right ankle sprain, FantasyPros reports, and further testing could expand Tyler Allgeier's role. Love is on The Champ. Tyjae Spears (TEN knee, out, week to week) and Emeka Egbuka (TB foot, Week 9 depends on rehab) are both on OBJAY.

Kyle Monangai (CHI turf toe) was ruled out in Week 8 with Chicago optimistic he returns in the coming weeks, and Jake Ferguson (DAL ankle) was ruled out with swelling being monitored. Monangai is on Asian Jim and Ferguson is on Kraft for Cash.

stories.title: The Champ and Bourbon Lover swap Joe Burrow for Lamar Jackson in a three-trade Friday
stories.dek: TJohn91 got Burrow, Tee Higgins and Mark Andrews. paknight12 got Jackson, Sam LaPorta, Tony Pollard and Keon Coleman, then flipped Zay Flowers to Kraft for Cash.
body: Three trades went through on Friday and two of them were nine-player and two-player deals between TJohn91 and paknight12. The big one at 1:13 PM ET sent Joe Burrow, Tee Higgins, Mark Andrews, Michael Pittman Jr. and Matt Hibner to The Champ. Bourbon Lover got Lamar Jackson, Sam LaPorta, Drew Lock and Zay Flowers, plus its own 2028 first-round pick back and two 2028 second-rounders. The Champ also got Hold My DK's 2029 second-rounder.

Then at 2:26 PM ET the same two teams did it again. Tony Pollard went to Bourbon Lover, Jordan Mason went to The Champ, and the two 2028 second-rounders went back to TJohn91. Pollard had 27.2 on the bench for The Champ in each of the last two weeks, so he finally got a new bench to sit on.

The third trade, at 5:51 PM ET, sent Keon Coleman and Kraft for Cash's two 2027 second-rounders to Bourbon Lover, and Zay Flowers to BTaylor1. That's Flowers on two rosters in under five hours after a 0.00 in Week 8.

Who won? On paper, The Champ. TJohn91 turned a 0.00 from Lamar Jackson into Burrow, who had 49.48 last week, plus Higgins at 36.0. Jackson hurt his thumb on his first play in Week 8, and coach Jesse Minter says he could miss the rest of the season (EssentiallySports). paknight12 took on that injured quarterback on a 3‑5 team with a 29-59 all-play, which is a dynasty bet on 2027 and beyond. Pittman is on IR too.

Bourbon Lover still plays Hold My DK this week as a 35.0-point underdog, and The Champ is a 25.5-point underdog against LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix. Both lines were set on Friday morning's rosters, so the real numbers are different.

columns.title: 3 trade tips from Holden McGroin, who watched Zay Flowers change teams twice in one day
columns.dek: Zero points, two new rosters, one lesson.
body: 1. If a player scores 0.00, trade him at 1:13 PM. If he still scores nothing, trade him again at 5:51 PM. Zay Flowers did that Friday and it's called volume.
2. Trade your quarterback for an injured quarterback. Bourbon Lover sent Joe Burrow's 49.48 away for Lamar Jackson, who needs thumb surgery. That's a bold way to see how it feels.
3. Always get your own first-round pick back. paknight12 did, and it's the best part of the whole day.
